claim: The StartExecution throttle token refill rate is 300 per second in us-east-1, us-west-2 and eu-west-1, and 150 per second in each of the other supported Regions. The quota is adjustable.
question: StartExecution throttling for Standard workflows: refill rate by Region?

qualifiers.scope: StartExecution token refill rate per second, per account, by Region
qualifiers.condition: 300 in us-east-1, us-west-2 and eu-west-1; 150 in each of the other supported Regions.
